name: Fejk Novella: Simuljator Tjan
source:
You are about to experience hyper-realistic girls simulator, which is also happens to be a visual novel. Girls have very special and unique logic. Meet our characters and judge for yourself:

Tsundere - evil on the first glance, she loves you deep inside. Very very deep…
The maid - she works for an ordinary guy just because she wants to. God forbid he’ll upset her with anything... 
Fake sister - There’s no true fan service without horny girl claiming to be main characters sister, you know.
Yandere - she loves you and murders, preferably murders of everyone except you, so she can be your only one.

Don’t bother about fails, there are more than 20 achievements and nice manga style graphics to cheer you up ;)

P.S. Don’t take this game too seriously, girls can be cute sometimes. Some of them. Probably. Moving on.
P.P.S. If your girlfriend complains that you don’t understand her, give her our game.
P.P.P.S. Good luck in your personal affairs, Bro!
translation:
你即将体验一款超写实女孩模拟器，同时它也是一部视觉小说。女孩们拥有非常特殊而独特的逻辑。来认识我们的角色，自己判断吧：

傲娇——第一眼看上去很邪恶，内心却深深爱着你。非常、非常深……
女仆——她只是因为自己愿意，才为一个普通男人工作。天啊，千万别惹她生气……
假妹妹——没有一个声称是主角妹妹的好色女孩，就不算真正的福利，你懂的。
病娇——她爱着你，也会杀人；最好杀光除了你以外的所有人，这样你就只属于她。

不用在意失败，超过20个成就和可爱的漫画风美术会让你开心起来。

附言：别把这款游戏当得太认真，女孩们有时也会很可爱。有些女孩吧。大概。继续。

附言2：如果你的女朋友抱怨你不理解她，就把我们的游戏给她。

附言3：祝你个人生活顺利，兄弟！
